components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--td-accent, #1d4ed8); color: #ffffff; border: 1px solid var(--td-accent, #1d4ed8); border-radius: 6px; padding: 8px 16px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 140ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--td-accent-hover, #1e40af); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(29,78,216,0.22); }

components.name: Theme Switcher
components.description: Three-way Light / System / Dark segmented control.
components.css: .ds-theme-switch { display: inline-flex; gap: 2px; padding: 2px; background: var(--td-bg-subtle, #f4f6f9); border: 1px solid var(--td-border-subtle, #e4e8f0); border-radius: 6px; } .ds-theme-opt { border: none; background: transparent; color: var(--td-text-muted, #667085); padding: 4px 10px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-theme-opt.is-active { background: var(--td-bg-surface, #ffffff); color: var(--td-text-primary, #111827); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(15,23,42,0.06); }

components.name: Status Pill
components.description: Semantic status indicator with leading dot.
components.css: .ds-pill-success { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--td-success, #047857); background: var(--td-success-soft, #ecfdf5); border: 1px solid var(--td-success-border, #a7f3d0); font-family: ui-monospace, monospace; } .ds-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; }

components.name: Hash Copy Chip
components.description: Monospace canonical case_hash chip with copy affordance.
components.css: .ds-hash-chip { border: 1px solid var(--td-border-subtle, #e4e8f0); background: var(--td-bg-subtle, #f4f6f9); color: var(--td-text-secondary, #475467); border-radius: 4px; padding: 2px 8px; font-size: 12px; font-family: ui-monospace, monospace; cursor: pointer; } .ds-hash-chip:hover { border-color: var(--td-accent-border, #bfd4ff); color: var(--td-accent, #1d4ed8); }

narrative.overview: TraceDelta is built as a calibrated engineering bench for evaluating and diagnosing AI applications. Both Light (Precision Paper) and Dark (Carbon Bench) themes are first-class citizens, paired with live prefers-color-scheme system synchronization.
keyCharacteristics: Dual first-class Light, Dark, and System-following theme architecture
Flat hairline-bordered work surfaces on distinct neutral planes
Single restrained Cobalt Signal accent reserved for primary actions and focus
Tabular monospace alignment on keys, hashes, timestamps, and telemetry
Unified 1.75px stroke inline SVG icon library

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Cobalt Signal appears on <= 10% of any viewport—only primary actions, current selection, and focus states.

rules.name: The Honest Mono Rule
rules.body: Use monospace strictly for code, JSON, hashes, keys, and numeric measurements.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Never nest cards inside cards; tables and toolbars share one hairline-bordered surface.

dos: Do declare every color through --td-* CSS custom properties so Light and Dark modes stay synchronized automatically.
Do pair every data table with skeleton loading, actionable empty states, and filtered empty states.
Do use td-mono and tabular-nums for case_key, case_hash, latency (ms), token counts, and timestamps.
Do keep transitions crisp (140ms-200ms) and bound strictly to state feedback.
donts: Don't hardcode hex colors inside Vue components or mix Element Plus default blue with custom palette accents.
Don't place eyebrow/kicker labels above page headings or nest el-card inside another card.
Don't use emoji or raw Unicode arrows in place of TdIcon.vue SVG icons.
Don't use gradient text, zero-offset neon glows, or decorative glassmorphism on Operate workbenches.
